question_text: The Local Government Code of 1991 (Republic Act No. 7160) devolves significant powers and responsibilities from the national government to local government units (LGUs). It mandates that LGUs, including provinces, cities, municipalities, and barangays, have the authority to manage their own affairs, create their own sources of revenue, and deliver basic services such as health, education, and infrastructure. The Code also establishes the principle of local autonomy, meaning LGUs can make decisions independently within the framework of national laws. According to the passage, which of the following is a responsibility devolved to LGUs?

options.text: Delivery of basic services like health and education
